sections.Description:
In Stern’s John Wick pinball games, players step into the role of the world’s greatest assassin as he fights to escape his past.

As the titular character, players can engage in high-speed car chases and fast-action drifting across the playfield, which incorporates models and artwork inspired by iconic locations from the franchise, including the New York Continental Hotel and the Red Circle Club, all set against a dramatically edge lit New York City skyline.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- High-speed Car Chases: Custom designed John Wick muscle car bash toy with fast-action motorized drifting effect in the center of the playfield.
- Take the Blood Oath: Players must use the motorized sculpted Blood Oath Marker carefully – or risk the consequences.
- Collect Weapons: Players can also open John Wick’s weapons crate to reveal a hidden shot target path to retrieve an array of weapons.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Including custom dialogue performed by Golden Globe® Award winning actor Ian McShane.
- Industry-first AI Game Mode System featuring illuminate enemy icons that react dynamically to challenge the player with a new experience every game.
- Through Stern's award-winning Insider Connected™ platform, players can track progress, earn new game-specific Achievements, and connect to the galaxy on a pinball adventure of a lifetime.

Premium:
- An original soundtrack composed by Charlie Benante of Anthrax and Pantera fame
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch.
- Players take on objective based "Faction Contracts" issued through new app notifications in Stern's award-winning Insider Connected™ system

Limited Edition:
- Featuring immersive high resolution film footage and audio assets from all four blockbuster films
- Expression Lighting System™ with intelligent full color spectrum RGB LEDs; synchronized & responsive to game events
- Players take on objective based "Faction Contracts" issued through new app notifications in Stern's award-winning Insider Connected™ system
